text: {"rules":[{"id":"BCS-SCREEN-40-74","version":"April 2024","title":"Breast Cancer: Screening: women aged 40 to 74 years","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends biennial screening mammography for women aged 40 to 74 years.","grade":"B","effective_date":"April 2024","action":"Biennial screening mammography","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"sex\": {\"is\": \"F\"}, \"quote\": \"women\"}, {\"age\": {\"min\": 40, \"max\": 74, \"at\": \"end\"}, \"quote\": \"women aged 40 to 74 years\", \"note\": \"Age evaluated at end of measurement year; the text does not specify the evaluation point.\"}], \"quote\": \"for women aged 40 to 74 years\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"mammogram\", \"window\": [\"{MY-1}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"biennial screening mammography\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"'biennial' means every 2 years, so for a December-31 check a mammogram in the measurement year or the prior year ({MY-1}-01-01 to {MY}-12-31) satisfies it\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["The footnote markers '†' (on the description) and '*' (on the date) refer to text not included in this section; any conditions they carry are not represented.","No exclusions (e.g., bilateral mastectomy, hospice) are stated in the section text, so none were encoded.","The point at which age is evaluated (end of measurement year) is an implementation choice; the text only states 'women aged 40 to 74 years'.","The biennial window ({MY-1}-01-01 to {MY}-12-31) is derived from 'biennial' and flagged for human review."]}
